content:
Apple today released the watchOS 27.0.1 update for Apple Watch. Apple says this update fixes an issue that caused some Apple Watch devices to unexpectedly restart. The update is only available to Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users.

以下是 watchOS 27.0.1 嘅完整發布公告：

On Reddit and other discussion forums, some Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 users reported that their new watches would randomly restart several times throughout the day. While not all users were affected, it was clearly a bug, and hopefully the software update released today will resolve the issue.

Has your Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 experienced any issues? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
